# S6: ELECTRONIC DOCUMENTS

**Pillar:** Social Criteria  
**Points:** 1

## Description
All electronic documents comply with the W3C WCAG 2.0 Level A standard or comply with the ISO standard for PDF/UA accessibility standard.

## Why it matters
Accessibility of all electronic documents, including Web pages.
